list.name: realm

options.content: 北京时间04:00切日；金额单位为金币，许可单位为1许可=100万金币额度。图表显示完整经济日快照；空值表示缺数据。月卡美元值为等价估值，不是提现收入。此面板只读，不控制游戏资产。

panels.title: 每日三层销毁金币当量
panels.description: 只计实际永久销毁；转移给其他玩家的货物不计销毁。

targets.rawSql:
WITH calendar AS (
  SELECT d::date AS economy_date,
    ((d::date + 1) + time '04:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS period_end
  FROM generate_series(
    (to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 1,
    (to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date,
    interval '1 day') d
)
SELECT c.period_end AS time,
  CASE WHEN o.is_complete IS TRUE THEN o.burn_daily_gold ELSE NULL END AS "日常保底",
  CASE WHEN o.is_complete IS TRUE THEN o.burn_light_pvp_gold ELSE NULL END AS "轻PVP",
  CASE WHEN o.is_complete IS TRUE THEN o.burn_sabuk_gold ELSE NULL END AS "沙巴克脉冲"
FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN public.hunting_permit_daily_observations o
  ON o.economy_date = c.economy_date AND o.realm_id IN (${realm:sqlstring})
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.period_end)
  AND c.period_end <= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' - interval '4 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') + interval '4 hours'
ORDER BY c.period_end ASC;

panels.title: 许可每日新增、消耗与衰减
panels.description: 许可原子在查询时除以1,000,000；不使用金币数充当许可数量。

targets.rawSql:
WITH calendar AS (
  SELECT d::date AS economy_date,
    ((d::date + 1) + time '04:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS period_end
  FROM generate_series(
    (to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 1,
    (to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date,
    interval '1 day') d
)
SELECT c.period_end AS time,
  CASE WHEN o.is_complete IS TRUE THEN o.permit_minted_atoms / 1000000.0 ELSE NULL END AS "实际新增许可",
  CASE WHEN o.is_complete IS TRUE THEN o.permit_consumed_atoms / 1000000.0 ELSE NULL END AS "玩家消耗许可",
  CASE WHEN o.is_complete IS TRUE THEN o.permit_decayed_atoms / 1000000.0 ELSE NULL END AS "衰减许可"
FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN public.hunting_permit_daily_observations o
  ON o.economy_date = c.economy_date AND o.realm_id IN (${realm:sqlstring})
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.period_end)
  AND c.period_end <= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' - interval '4 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') + interval '4 hours'
ORDER BY c.period_end ASC;

panels.title: 绑定与可交易金币日结存量
panels.description: 包括在线和离线钱包、行会、托管、邮件未领取金币；所有权唯一计数。存量基准不能使用7200万/天流量。

targets.rawSql:
WITH calendar AS (
  SELECT d::date AS economy_date,
    ((d::date + 1) + time '04:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS period_end
  FROM generate_series(
    (to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 1,
    (to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date,
    interval '1 day') d
)
SELECT c.period_end AS time,
  CASE WHEN o.is_complete IS TRUE THEN o.bound_gold_stock ELSE NULL END AS "绑定金币",
  CASE WHEN o.is_complete IS TRUE THEN o.unbound_gold_stock ELSE NULL END AS "非绑定金币",
  CASE WHEN o.is_complete IS TRUE THEN o.unbound_stock_baseline_gold ELSE NULL END AS "非绑定稳态基准",
  CASE WHEN o.is_complete IS TRUE THEN o.unbound_stock_baseline_gold * 1.30 ELSE NULL END AS "通胀130%",
  CASE WHEN o.is_complete IS TRUE THEN o.unbound_stock_baseline_gold * 0.70 ELSE NULL END AS "通缩70%"
FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN public.hunting_permit_daily_observations o
  ON o.economy_date = c.economy_date AND o.realm_id IN (${realm:sqlstring})
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.period_end)
  AND c.period_end <= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' - interval '4 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') + interval '4 hours'
ORDER BY c.period_end ASC;

panels.title: 经济数据完整性（0正常 / 1异常）
panels.description: 覆盖最近10个闭合经济日、资金字段、画像互斥和配置基准。缺失的价格保持NULL；无成交价格不是零。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' - interval '4 hours')::date - 1) AS closed_date
), calendar AS (
  SELECT r.realm_id, d::date AS economy_date
  FROM public.hunting_permit_observability_realms r CROSS JOIN bounds b
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(b.closed_date - (10 - 1), b.closed_date, interval '1 day') d
  WHERE r.enabled IS TRUE
)
SELECT now() AS time, c.realm_id,
  CASE WHEN count(o.economy_date) = 10
    AND bool_and(o.is_complete IS TRUE)
    AND bool_and((o.burn_daily_gold IS NOT NULL AND o.burn_daily_gold >= 0 AND
      o.burn_light_pvp_gold IS NOT NULL AND o.burn_light_pvp_gold >= 0 AND
      o.burn_sabuk_gold IS NOT NULL AND o.burn_sabuk_gold >= 0 AND
      o.permit_minted_atoms IS NOT NULL AND o.permit_minted_atoms >= 0 AND
      o.permit_consumed_atoms IS NOT NULL AND o.permit_consumed_atoms >= 0 AND
      o.permit_decayed_atoms IS NOT NULL AND o.permit_decayed_atoms >= 0 AND
      o.permit_closing_atoms IS NOT NULL AND o.permit_closing_atoms >= 0 AND
      o.bound_gold_stock IS NOT NULL AND o.bound_gold_stock >= 0 AND
      o.unbound_gold_stock IS NOT NULL AND o.unbound_gold_stock >= 0 AND
      o.gross_converted_gold IS NOT NULL AND o.gross_converted_gold >= 0 AND
      o.conversion_fee_gold IS NOT NULL AND o.conversion_fee_gold >= 0 AND
      o.net_unbound_inflow_gold IS NOT NULL AND o.net_unbound_inflow_gold >= 0 AND
      o.unbound_stock_baseline_gold > 0 AND o.burn_baseline_gold > 0
      AND o.planned_daily_consumption_atoms > 0
      AND o.policy_version IS NOT NULL AND length(o.policy_version) > 0
      AND o.period_end = ((o.economy_date + 1) + time '04:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'
      AND o.gross_converted_gold::numeric = o.conversion_fee_gold::numeric + o.net_unbound_inflow_gold::numeric
      AND o.active_casual_accounts IS NOT NULL AND o.active_casual_accounts >= 0
      AND o.active_light_pvp_accounts IS NOT NULL AND o.active_light_pvp_accounts >= 0
      AND o.active_sabuk_accounts IS NOT NULL AND o.active_sabuk_accounts >= 0
      AND o.active_account_total = o.active_casual_accounts + o.active_light_pvp_accounts + o.active_sabuk_accounts) IS TRUE)
  THEN 0.0 ELSE 1.0 END AS value
FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN public.hunting_permit_daily_observations o
  ON o.realm_id = c.realm_id AND o.economy_date = c.economy_date
GROUP BY c.realm_id ORDER BY c.realm_id
) health WHERE realm_id IN (${realm:sqlstring});
